variant_scan.rule: serialized order, strictly greater score wins, cache keyed by requested set

requested_keywords.rule: pass-context (global + renderer) keywords OR material keywords, unmasked

tier_filter.rule: tier >= 3 or tier == GraphicsCaps active tier; tier=None admits only tier >= 3 and fails if a stage has tier-specific subprograms

requirements_filter.rule: (requirements & caps) == requirements; not evaluated without a caps mask

light_mode_first_pass.rule: LightMode -> pass index table keeps the first pass of each LightMode

light_mode_default_always.rule: a pass without a LightMode tag is LightMode Always

shadow_caster_pass.rule: active subshader's own ShadowCaster pass, else the shader-level fallback-resolved ShadowCaster pass

shadow_caster_fallback_resolution.rule: the shader-level ShadowCaster is taken from the Fallback chain

active_subshader.rule: first supported subshader with LOD <= min(shader.maximumLOD, globalMaximumLOD); none -> Fallback shader

replacement_shader.rule: Camera.RenderWithShader(shader, tag): empty tag renders every object with the replacement active subshader; otherwise the object shader tag value selects the first replacement subshader carrying an equal value; no match -> not rendered

use_pass.rule: UsePass "Shader/PASS" -> passes named PASS in that shader

state_property_binding.rule: a pass state value with a property name takes the material float
